newsitem.title: HONG KONG: Jiangling sees 96 net profit surge.
newsitem.headline: Jiangling sees 96 net profit surge.

text.p: Jiangling Motors Co Ltd said on Tuesday it expected net profit to leap to about 60 million yuan in 1996 from 7.73 million yuan in 1995.
The firm reported after-tax profit of 117.24 million yuan in 1994.

The surge in 1996 profit was helped by a new line of vehicles such as security trucks for transporting money, a company spokesman told the Hong Kong-based newsletter China Securities Bulletin on Tuesday.
Jiangling produced 15,472 vehicles in 1996 compared with 22,000 in 1995, the official said. It sold 16,972 in 1996, he said without giving a comparative figure.
Jiangling plans to offer new B shares to raise funds for market expansion and product development, the spokesman said. He gave no other details.
